rows.note: Use this sports term when bringing a ball carrier to the ground by tackling them.

example.english: That rugby player used a tackle to bring the ball carrier to the ground.
example.traditional: 嗰個欖球員一記擒抱，將持球手撳咗落地。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 laam2 kau4 jyun4 jat1 gei3 kam4 pou5 zoeng1 ci4 kau4 sau2 gam6 zo2 lok6 dei6

rows.note: Use this more general colloquial construction when describing the physical act of knocking the ball carrier down rather than naming the sports technique.

example.english: When we saw the opponent carrying the ball, we rushed over and used a tackle to knock him down.
example.traditional: 我哋見到對方帶波，就衝埋去將佢撲低咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 deoi3 fong1 daai3 bo1 zau6 cung1 maai4 heoi3 zoeng1 keoi5 pok3 dai1 zo2
